title: Ensure SSH empty passwords are not permitted
description: Disallowing empty passwords ensures all SSH user authentication requires valid credentials.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-LNX-SSH-001 (custom example rule based on CIS Ubuntu Linux 22.04 LTS Benchmark principles)
remediation: Set 'PermitEmptyPasswords no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart sshd.

title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled
description: Direct root login over SSH bypasses individual user accountability.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-LNX-SSH-002 (custom example rule based on CIS Ubuntu Linux 22.04 LTS Benchmark principles)
remediation: Set 'PermitRootLogin no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart sshd.

title: Ensure password hashing algorithm is SHA-512
description: Weak password hashing (MD5, DES) makes offline brute-force attacks feasible.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-LNX-PASS-003 (custom example rule based on CIS Ubuntu Linux 22.04 LTS Benchmark principles)
remediation: Ensure 'password [success=1 default=ignore] pam_unix.so obscure sha512' is present in /etc/pam.d/common-password.

title: Ensure a firewall is active (ufw or iptables)
description: An active host-based firewall provides defence-in-depth against unauthorized network access.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-LNX-FW-004 (custom example rule based on CIS Ubuntu Linux 22.04 LTS Benchmark principles)
remediation: Enable ufw with 'ufw enable' or ensure iptables has a deny-all default policy.

title: Ensure cron daemon is running
description: Cron is required for scheduled security-related tasks such as log rotation and integrity checks.
remediation: Enable and start cron: 'systemctl enable --now cron'.
